## TaskGroup vs gather

`asyncio.TaskGroup` cancels siblings on failure (structured concurrency). Prefer it for related tasks.

## Connection pools

One async worker can multiplex thousands of requests. Size DB pools relative to workers × concurrent awaits, or you'll hit `too many connections`.

## CPU-bound

Offload to processes/queues — threads still contend on the GIL for pure Python CPU work.
